category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, and Procedures (PR.PO-P)
subcategory_text: Response and recovery plans are tested.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: CP-4 (Contingency Plan Testing), IR-3 (Incident Response Testing)
implementation_examples: Test response and recovery plans on a defined cadence, covering privacy-relevant scenarios (data deletion incident, breach with notification trigger)
Capture lessons and refresh plans accordingly
Hold joint exercises with third parties where recovery depends on them
assessment_objectives: Determine whether response and recovery plans are tested on cadence
Determine whether tests cover privacy-relevant scenarios
Determine whether lessons are captured and plans refreshed
Determine whether third-party dependencies are exercised
